title: An unplanned file is refused under fixed: and warned about elsewhere, in Claude Code and Codex
verdict: PASS in Claude Code; PASS in Codex after agent-skills #624 (before it, Codex on an untrusted fresh copy ran no guard)
method: Fresh copy of the AES template (uvx copier copy --trust --defaults from AES 9a1138c79, project unplanned-proof). Its lockstep.yaml governs src/unplanned_proof/ and marks it fixed:. One plan change added scripts/ as governed but not fixed. Each client was told to create two files no layout row names, src/unplanned_proof/extra.py (fixed) and scripts/hello.py (not fixed), not to retry a refused write, and to quote any hook message.

claude.hook: template .claude/settings.json PreToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Bash -> uv run --quiet lockstep-hook
claude.result: extra.py refused (PreToolUse:Write hook error, the refusal lists the three planned files); hello.py written with the same text as a 'Lockstep would block this edit (warn mode)' warning; the agent quoted both

codex_untrusted_before_fix.result: FAIL: both files written, no hook message, no hook log row. Codex printed 'Untrusted project-local configuration is disabled', so the template's .codex/hooks.json did not load, and the global fallback (agent-skills #623) skipped because that file names lockstep-hook.

codex_trusted.result: PASS: extra.py refused by the project hook, hello.py written with the warning; the trust entry --trust wrote was removed afterwards (config.toml matched its backup)

codex_untrusted_after_fix.fix: agent-skills #624 (b65da97): the global Codex fallback stands down only when the project names lockstep-hook and ~/.codex/config.toml trusts it; three-case test with a stand-in uvx passed (untrusted+own hook runs, trusted+own hook skips, no own hook runs). Applied with scripts/rulesync_sync.sh apply; the live ~/.codex/hooks.json differs from its backup in that one line.
codex_untrusted_after_fix.result: PASS: extra.py refused by the global fallback, hello.py written with the warning

hook_log: ~/.local/state/lockstep/unplanned/hook-2026-11-27.jsonl: 8 rows; deny extra.py and would_block hello.py at 03:18:14 (Claude), 03:20:18/03:20:22 (Codex trusted), 03:22:56/03:22:59 (Codex after fix); no rows for the failing Codex run
caveat: features.hooks = false in Brian's ~/.codex/config.toml (agent-skills #410, on purpose), so everyday Codex sessions run no hooks at all; each Codex run here turned hooks on for that run only. The warn message lists the planned files of the package folder even when the write is under scripts/.
